title.zh: Uranium Finance Hacker Who Bought Pokémon and Magic Cards Convicted Over $50M Theft
title.en: Uranium Finance Hacker Who Bought Pokémon and Magic Cards Convicted Over $50M Theft

current_state.zh: A Manhattan jury convicted Jonathan Spalletta of computer fraud and money laundering for the 2021 Uranium Finance hacks that netted over $50 million, which he laundered through Tornado Cash and spent on collectible trading cards.
